ops.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_cli_retirement_guard.py -q > /tmp/g5-guard.log 2>&1; ! grep -oE '^E +(skills|specs|[.]agent-work)/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+' /tmp/g5-guard.log | sed 's/^E *//' | grep -qv '^skills/workbench/' && T=$(mktemp -d) && cp -r tests skills specs scripts "$T"/ && mkdir -p "$T/.agent-work" && cp -r .agent-work/templates "$T/.agent-work"/ && rm -rf "$T/skills/workbench" && python3 -m pytest "$T/tests/test_cli_retirement_guard.py" -q >/dev/null 2>&1; R=$?; rm -rf "$T"; exit $R
